title: The Observable Wasserstein Distance
abstract: arXiv:2605.09916v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce the observable Wasserstein distance, a framework for deriving lower bounds on the Wasserstein distance between probability measures on Polish metric spaces, designed to bypass the computational intractability of exact optimal transport in large-scale, non-Euclidean datasets. Analogous to the sliced Wasserstein distance in $\mathbb{R}^d$, our approach projects measures onto the real line via 1-Lipschitz observables and computes the Wasserstein distances between the resulting pushforward distributions. We define a hierarchy of pseudo-metrics by restricting observables to a nested chain of subspaces. A central theoretical contribution is an injectivity result linking the metric covering dimension of the support of a measure to the specific order in the hierarchy that guarantees unique recovery. translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.09916v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：我们引入了可观测Wasserstein距离，这是一个用于推导波兰度量空间上概率测度之间Wasserstein距离下界的框架，旨在绕过大规模非欧几里得数据集中精确最优传输的计算难题。类似于$\mathbb{R}^d$中的切片Wasserstein距离，我们的方法通过1-Lipschitz可观测函数将测度投影到实线上，并计算所得推前分布之间的Wasserstein距离。我们通过将可观测函数限制在一嵌套子空间链中，定义了一个伪度量层次结构。一个核心理论贡献是注入性结果，该结果将测度支撑的度量覆盖维度与保证唯一恢复的层次结构中的特定阶数联系起来。这作为欧几里得分布中Cramér-Wold装置的度量空间类比。我们证明了这一层次结构的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出一种可观测Wasserstein距离框架，通过1-Lipschitz投影和层次化伪度量，为高维非欧几里得数据提供可计算的下界，并建立了与度量覆盖维度相关的注入性恢复结果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the observable Wasserstein distance, a framework using 1-Lipschitz projections and hierarchical pseudo-metrics to provide computable lower bounds for high-dimensional non-Euclidean data, with an injectivity result linking metric covering dimension to unique recovery.
